name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 27, after point b – Am 92
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ba) Emphasizes that the granting of EU development aid should be conditional on effective cooperation by partner countries regarding the return and readmission of their nationals residing illegally in the EU; believes that such an approach would strengthen the coherence of the EU’s external policies and ensure a more responsible use of European funds;
